import urllib.request
import json

url = "https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/rest/pug/compound/cid/2599/JSON"
req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0'})
with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as resp:
    cid_data = json.loads(resp.read().decode())

# Check title, synonyms, properties
props = cid_data['PC_Compounds'][0]['props']
for p in props:
    label = p.get('urn', {}).get('label', '')
    name = p.get('urn', {}).get('name', '')
    val = p.get('value', {})
    if 'weight' in label.lower() or 'weight' in name.lower() or 'formula' in label.lower() or 'formula' in name.lower():
        print(label, name, val)
